GeneDef.label: life force
GeneDef.description: Wraith tissues store stolen vitality as a visible Life Force reserve. The reserve slowly drains with time and is restored by feeding.
GeneDef.resourceDescription: Stored vitality used by Wraith biology. Feeding restores this reserve.

GeneDef.label: wraith regeneration
GeneDef.description: Wraith tissue slowly repairs ordinary injuries while Life Force remains. A recently fed Wraith regenerates much faster.

GeneDef.label: wraith feeding organs
GeneDef.description: Specialized Wraith tissues can either fully drain or partially feed from a downed biological pawn.
